org.name: Department of Health and Social Care

theme: Community health care and emergency services related deaths

reports.title: Peter Scott
categories: Community health care and emergency services related deaths
Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

promises.quote: In 2015/16, the trust carried out a significant recruitment campaign and educated 350 whole time equivalent frontline posts.
promises.summary: Trust will recruit 350 frontline staff to improve ambulance resources.

concerns.quote: I remain very concerned about resource issues for this ambulance service. I raised similar concerns in a Prevention of Future Deaths Report in the case of MG, dated 11 May 2016.
I consider that there is a risk of future deaths as set out above unless an urgent review of resources is undertaken.
Consideration should be given to strategies to improve handover times at hospitals.

reports.title: Rita Taylor: Prevention of future deaths report

concerns.quote: insufficient ambulance service resources to meet the needs of the City of Milton Keynes

reports.title: Christopher Hart: Prevention of future deaths report

concerns.quote: continuing and regular instances of non-availability of ambulances occurring in Suffolk and the wider East of England region

had an ambulance for Christopher arrived within the target time, the drugs he could have been given by ambulance personnel, and his early transport to hospital, would on a balance of probabilities have saved his life
continuing lack of sufficient ambulance resource in Suffolk will lead to future loss of life

reports.title: David Briggs: Prevention of future deaths report

concerns.quote: The ambulance service was called at 2049 on 14 November 2022 and the call was graded as a Category 2 call requiring a response within 40 minutes. The ambulance finally arrived at 0044 on 15 November 2022
YAS were not resourced to respond to the number of emergency calls
There was a significant delay in offloading patients at hospitals which tied up ambulance resource and meant they were unable to respond to emergency calls

reports.title: Jade Griffiths-Jones: Prevention of future deaths report

promises.quote: Ambulance services received £200 million of additional funding in 2023/24 to expand capacity and improve response times.
promises.summary: Funding to expand ambulance capacity and improve response times.

concerns.quote: availability of ambulance crews is continuing to be compromised by delays at hospitals resulting in delays in response times which creates a risk to the life
concerns.hazard: ambulance crew availability compromised by hospital delays

concerns.quote: could not resource the category 2 disposition within national target times (mean average of 18 minutes, 90th centile of 40 minutes)
Trust was experiencing increased volume of calls and significant hospital delays and therefore could not resource the category 2 disposition within national target times
3 available ambulance resource within the sector at that point in time with 54 Category 2 and 43 Category 3 cases awaiting resource allocation
concerns.hazard: insufficient ambulance resources relative to demand

concerns.quote: West Midlands Ambulance Service continue to fail to meet target response times and have been made the subject of a regulation 12 notice on this topic by the CQC
concerns.hazard: failure to meet response time targets

concerns.quote: if hospital handover delays didn't exist they would be likely to be meeting their response targets as they did before hospital delays became chronic
concerns.hazard: hospital handover delays prevent target response achievement

reports.title: Harry Dunn: Prevention of Future Deaths Report (1)
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

promises.quote: the Health Secretary has ordered a full and independent investigation into NHS performance to provide a frank assessment of the issues and challenges it faces

concerns.quote: When the 999 call was made shortly following the accident no resources were available within either the operating area of the relevant ambulance trust, East Midlands Ambulance Service Trust
EMAS was unable to meet mean response standards at the time of the 999 call
concerns.hazard: ambulance service unable to meet response standards

concerns.quote: I am concerned that these continuing delays for ambulances at hospital handovers reflects a risk of deaths into the future

reports.title: Diana Fairweather-Purkis: Prevention of Future Deaths Report

concerns.quote: There is insufficient Ambulance Service availability/resource to enable Ambulances to attend to patients in a timely manner and in accordance with relevant target attendance times.
There are excessive delays in Ambulance crews being released following attendance at hospital, due to delays in patients being handed over to hospital staff.
